app_type.description:
This is the application type this engine resource represents.
The supported values: 'APP_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED', 'APP_TYPE_INTRANET'.

collection_id.rationale: Identifier referencing a collection. We do not constrain resource identifiers or references to other resources.

data_store_ids.description: The data stores associated with this engine. For SOLUTION_TYPE_SEARCH type of engines, they can only associate with at most one data store.
data_store_ids.rationale: List of identifiers referencing the data stores linked to the engine. We do not constrain references to other resources.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

disable_analytics.description: Whether to disable analytics for searches performed on this engine.

display_name.description: Required. The display name of the engine. Should be human readable. UTF-8 encoded string with limit of 1024 characters.
display_name.rationale: Human-readable display name for the engine. Cosmetic metadata with no security effect.

engine_id.description: Unique ID to use for Search Engine App.
engine_id.rationale: Identifier for the engine resource. We do not constrain resource identifiers, so it is not a policy target.

features.description: A map of the feature config for the engine to opt in or opt out of features.

industry_vertical.description: The industry vertical that the engine registers. The restriction of the Engine industry vertical is based on DataStore: If unspecified, default to GENERIC. Vertical on Engine has to match vertical of the DataStore liniked to the engine. Default value: "GENERIC" Possible values: ["GENERIC", "MEDIA", "HEALTHCARE_FHIR"]
industry_vertical.rationale: Selects the engine's industry vertical (GENERIC/MEDIA/HEALTHCARE_FHIR). It must match the linked data store but is a functional configuration choice, not a security control; a generic policy here would not improve security.

kms_key_name.description:
The KMS key to be used to protect this Engine at creation time.

Must be set for requests that need to comply with CMEK Org Policy
protections.

If this field is set and processed successfully, the Engine will be
protected by the KMS key, as indicated in the cmek_config field.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project the resource belongs to. This is an identifier/reference and is not a security policy target.

common_config.description: Common config spec that specifies the metadata of the engine.

common_config.company_name.description: The name of the company, business or entity that is associated with the engine. Setting this may help improve LLM related features.cd

knowledge_graph_config.enable_cloud_know.description: Whether to enable the Cloud Knowledge Graph for the engine.

knowledge_graph_config.enable_private_kn.description: Whether to enable the Private Knowledge Graph for the engine.

knowledge_graph_config.feature_config.description: Feature config for the Knowledge Graph.

knowledge_graph_config.feature_config.di.description: Whether to disable the private KG auto complete for the engine.
Whether to disable the private KG enrichment for the engine.
Whether to disable the private KG for query UI chips.
Whether to disable the private KG query understanding for the engine.

search_engine_config.required_subscripti.description:
The required subscription tier of this engine.

They cannot be modified after engine creation. If the required subscription tier is search, user with higher license tier like assist can still access the standalone app associated with this engine. Possible values: ["SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_UNSPECIFIED", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_SEARCH", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_SEARCH_AND_ASSISTANT", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_FRONTLINE_WORKER", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_AGENTSPACE_STARTER", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_AGENTSPACE_BUSINESS", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_ENTERPRISE", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_ENTERPRISE_EMERGING", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_EDU", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_EDU_PRO", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_EDU_EMERGING", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_EDU_PRO_EMERGING", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_FRONTLINE_STARTER"]

search_engine_config.search_add_ons.description: The add-on that this search engine enables. Possible values: ["SEARCH_ADD_ON_LLM"]

search_engine_config.search_tier.description: The search feature tier of this engine. Defaults to SearchTier.SEARCH_TIER_STANDARD if not specified. Default value: "SEARCH_TIER_STANDARD" Possible values: ["SEARCH_TIER_STANDARD", "SEARCH_TIER_ENTERPRISE"]
